\caption[Net correctness gain per model and variant (R04, Q06)]{Net correctness gain per model and variant (R04, Q06). Population: BASE paired with FINAL[v] (identical base-cell cohort per model); unit: base cell; block: composite. Composite block; cell = R04 net gain of Q06 correctness pass (FINAL[v] - BASE) in percentage points; blue = gain, red = loss, gray midpoint = 0 (colour scale beside the plot); bold value = its 95\% CI excludes 0 (a degenerate zero-width interval is never bold; its value carries \dag{}); descriptive per model (unadjusted CIs, no test, no ranking). CIs (in the data CSV): 95\% CI: nonparametric cluster bootstrap, percentile intervals, stratified by block (pilot benchmarks resampled among the 12 pilot benchmarks, full\_ext among its 48); seed 20261017; cluster = benchmark; 2,000 replicates (descriptive, unadjusted). BL01: Includes dense\_la/00 (BL-01 tolerance convention: possible false FAIL verdicts; disclosure-bearing aggregate); sensitivity SA1 in T10. REASONING: Reasoning settings differ between models and are not equalised (see the closure disclosure register, item reasoning\_policy\_differences); some providers report no reasoning-token field. IC1: Q06 is in-sample for test\_feedback and combined\_feedback: their loops see the ParEval test verdict and stop when it passes (every stopped\_tests\_pass trajectory is a Q06 pass), so they optimise the endpoint; for static\_feedback Q06 is out-of-sample (measured once in phase 2, never seen by the loop). The variants therefore differ in trigger and stop rules, not only in feedback content; test\_feedback cannot regress on Q06 by construction. IC2: E02 is not an independent confirmation of Q06 gains: it counts build failures, and most E02 improvements are the same cells as the Q06 improvements; the held-out signal proper is the joint transition X06 (e.g. Q06 repaired but E02 still failing) and G01. IC6: static\_feedback repair triggers are dominated by clang-tidy bugprone findings and, on MPI, by low-confidence hints (design document: no trustworthy static MPI tool exists); static\_feedback results measure this frozen blocking-set configuration, not static analysis in general.}\label{fig:study_analysis_001:F3_heatmap_model_variant}
